name: mp4ff-745651cf-blind30-ots
instr:
# mp4ff-regen

Working with this media container library after a routine update, a scattered pile of misbehaviour turned up, none of it announced anywhere. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what we saw from the outside, with the neighbouring cases that still behave noted where we could check them.

Writing small structures out and reading them straight back in fails in a long list of places. A record pairing a maximum content light level with a maximum picture-average light level no longer survives the trip at all: what comes back out of the bytes just written does not compare equal to what went in, and a copy deliberately given a short declared length is accepted without complaint. The neighbouring record pairing a maximum content light level with a maximum frame-average light level still returns intact, but shortening its declared length by one byte is now swallowed in silence rather than refused. A record holding five signed offsets between when a sample is unpacked and when it is shown is wrong twice over: the length it claims for itself is twenty bytes short of what it actually writes, and the values come back wrong after a write-and-read-back cycle for both the form that stores each offset in four bytes and the form that stores it in eight, as if those two had traded places. A record announcing a timed cue whose scheme is named by a URI claims a length too small by exactly the length of that name, so it never reproduces itse
